method.sceneNeighborhood: 500 metre radius around an in-frame source-derived representative point; local WGS84 azimuthal-equidistant working CRS
method.anchorSelection: Exact profile-name match: point before polygon before line, then OSM before national source; choose in-frame geometry. Lines use their midpoint; polygons use an interior point. No production selections are changed.
method.expectedKindsMeaning: At least one catalog geometry of each expected kind intersects the geographic neighborhood. This is source existence evidence, not a browser viewport, label placement or painted visibility assertion.
method.featureExamples: Up to three nearest source-identity examples per expected kind; counts include all neighborhood matches.
method.selectionCaveat: Scene reports have aggregate selected counts and explicit omission IDs, not a positive per-feature paint inventory. Absence from their omission list is recorded only as not-explicitly-omitted.
method.preFixBrowserEvidence: artifacts/cartography/grand-canyon-coverage.json and sequoia-coverage.json predate fixes; neither is used to approve this baseline.
method.enrichmentInterpretation: Hydro duplicates are explicitly deduplicated source coverage, not missing geography. Unmatched GNIS identities have no explicit-ID match in other catalog features and remain standalone named features; this count is not missing-label or missing-source count.
method.physicalAndSemanticCounts: Catalog kind counts partition physical features. Semantic role counts overlap: a tagged building retains its footprint and also contributes a public POI role with the same source identity. Scene selected.poi counts those roles, not only physical kind=poi. A role-only omission never means its building footprint is missing.
method.candidateEvidence: snapshots.interactiveCandidate identifies the exact bytes used for the inspected Chromium source-to-paint evidence below. Later interactive-only defect fixes and release hashes are recorded separately; these screenshots are never relabeled as evidence for different bytes.
method.finalContentSnapshot: Cached-node normalization is incorporated in current catalog/scene/candidate snapshots. Raw acquisition bytes and provenance metadata were unchanged; the future explicit standalone-ford selector is not claimed as run.
method.paintNeighborhoodJoin: Source IDs are joined between catalog features within the independently defined 500 m geographic neighborhood and runtime-visible geometry or painted annotations. Camera-wide expected-kind presence is recorded separately; a whole-camera count is not a local-neighborhood coverage fraction. POI geometry evidence comes from symbol annotations, while point-label evidence is separately counted.

visualReviewScope.scope: All 21 actual-viewport images were inspected against their source/catalog/scene identities and runtime outcomes. This is bounded qualitative content/style evidence, not the separate all-engine collision, typography, interaction or promotion gate. Overview zoom clamps to the full map; actual ground scales are recorded per view.
limitations: Source retrieval/version records establish snapshots, not present-day geographic accuracy, access, seasonal conditions or universal source completeness.
Equivalent provider/editor destination names can remain as separate labels and add clutter.
Not every named feature can be painted at every camera state; area containment, path clearance, collisions, repeat spacing and detail gates intentionally omit labels.
Visible geometry IDs describe renderer visibility eligibility; screenshots substantiate the reviewed composition, not independent per-feature pixel detection.
